rationale: firebase-tools is a lockfile-pinned deploy/test CLI installed before production OIDC credentials. These advisories are confined to its non-runtime Pub/Sub telemetry and legacy gaxios dependency paths; neither path accepts visitor-controlled input in this repository. Runtime web and Functions dependency graphs must remain vulnerability-free. Re-reviewed 2026-11-07: firebase-tools 15.35.0 still carries both advisories plus further moderate transitive ones, so 15.33.0 stays pinned.
